ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface; macro-level ratio of dark pixels to high-intensity pixels is approximately 98:2.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a high depth-to-width pixel ratio at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys extending along the entire horizontal boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge, terminating in sharply defined lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal, dark crescent-shaped mark/fold is visible at the lower center where the fluke meets the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly dark, high-density pigmentation covering the entire visible ventral surface with an absence of characteristic white mottling.
